findings.evidence: Repository review confirms no candidate secret in scoped files, but artifacts state Gemini credential previously exposed in chat has not been verified revoked/replaced.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Live execution proceeds before verified rotation.
findings.required_correction: Revoke exposed credential, create replacement, and record dated non-secret owner rotation attestation. Never record key value.
findings.why_it_matters: Compromised credential may permit unauthorized quota/account use.

findings.evidence: Direct script invocation fails with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named src`.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Run `python scripts/run_phase5b_prompt_rag.py --help`.
findings.required_correction: Add repository root before repository imports or use an installed package entry point.
findings.why_it_matters: Executable freeze runner cannot start.

findings.changes_experimental_design_or_results: No design change; any mismatched execution would be invalid.
findings.evidence: Config is hashed but never loaded/enforced; prompt/query/chunk/ranking/trace paths remain arbitrary and frozen SHAs/request hashes are unchecked.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Supply alternate files and confirmation matching unchanged config.
findings.required_correction: Derive canonical paths from config and verify all file and per-request hashes before client creation.
findings.why_it_matters: A different reranker payload can run under nominal confirmation.

findings.evidence: Unvalidated query IDs become filename components under caller-selected output root.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Use a query ID containing path separators/`..`.
findings.required_correction: Require exact frozen R5 ID set, canonical output root, and safe filename encoding.
findings.why_it_matters: Malformed IDs can write outside approved output scope.

findings.evidence: Runner ignores `execution_authorized: false`, pending status, commit/tree, and dirty worktree.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Confirm only free-tier artifact, then invoke from uncommitted tree.
findings.required_correction: Require approved commit/tree, clean protected paths, and separate config-bound trace execution approval.
findings.why_it_matters: Offline pending freeze can call provider without distinct execution authorization.

findings.blocking_status: Blocks free-tier safety and live execution.
findings.evidence: Caller can reset count with new checkpoint; checkpoint accepts forged completed IDs/state; read-modify-write has no interprocess lock.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Use fresh checkpoint, two concurrent runners, or forged completed list.
findings.required_correction: Use one canonical config-bound locked ledger; validate exact state/plan and reconcile every completed raw artifact.
findings.why_it_matters: 24/26 caps can be bypassed or incomplete work can finalize as success.

findings.evidence: Raw response writes before ledger success; existing output is discovered only after redispatch; repeated quota failures reuse one filename.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Crash between response write and success record, then resume.
findings.required_correction: Use durable attempt states, preflight outputs, append-only failures, and recover verified response without redispatch.
findings.why_it_matters: Crash/resume duplicates calls or loses valid primary evidence.

findings.changes_experimental_design_or_results: No; mixed-version results would be invalid.
findings.evidence: Full ledger starts without trace-established modelVersion.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Trace returns A; stable alias changes; full accepts B.
findings.required_correction: Bind trace modelVersion and trace artifact hashes into full approval/ledger.
findings.why_it_matters: Trace and full primary rankings can mix different backend versions.

findings.evidence: Full gate accepts any JSON whose status string says repeatability passed plus matching owner approval hash.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Create minimal status-only trace decision.
findings.required_correction: Require strict schema and independently recompute thresholds/failures/modelVersion from all 24 trace artifacts.
findings.why_it_matters: Fabricated/stale trace decision can unlock remaining calls.

findings.evidence: Only Gemini `APIError` is mapped; transport timeout/connection exceptions escape despite frozen retry promise.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Mock client raising `httpx.TimeoutException`; one uncaught call occurs.
findings.required_correction: Map only preregistered transport exceptions to sanitized transient errors and preserve history.
findings.why_it_matters: Retry and checkpoint behavior differs from protocol.

findings.evidence: Sanitized provider exceptions retain original error/body through `__cause__`.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Format chained traceback from mocked error body marker.
findings.required_correction: Raise sanitized exceptions `from None`; retain class/status only.
findings.why_it_matters: Traceback logging can reveal provider response content prohibited by policy.

findings.evidence: Terminal errors discard attempt timestamps/history and invalid response metadata; runner stores only class/hash.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Exhaust retries or receive schema-invalid response.
findings.required_correction: Carry sanitized attempt history and credential-free raw response metadata in typed terminal record.
findings.why_it_matters: Frozen failure preservation contract is false.

findings.evidence: Seven recorded current hashes stale; runner/free-confirmation/evaluation protocol omitted; focused/full tests fail.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Run manifest hash test.
findings.required_correction: Regenerate complete manifest after all corrections; update test counts last.
findings.why_it_matters: Offline freeze is not valid or committable.

findings.evidence: Exact Gemini SDK pin exists only in prose/config, not installable dependency metadata or runtime check.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Install declared project dependencies only.
findings.required_correction: Add exact `google-genai[local-tokenizer]==2.13.0` dependency/lock and enforce runtime version.
findings.why_it_matters: Clean checkout cannot import/run frozen client reproducibly.

findings.blocking_status: Operational live-execution blocker and remaining uncertainty.
findings.evidence: Free-tier attestation binds config, not executing credential/project context. User constraints prohibit storing key/project identifiers.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Confirm one free project, then change environment key.
findings.required_correction: Require immediate owner attestation for actual execution environment and re-attestation after any credential-context change; store no secret/identifier.
findings.why_it_matters: Zero-charge guarantee remains procedural if environment credential changes.

findings.changes_experimental_design_or_results: No current Phase 0 values; malformed future run becomes rejected.
findings.evidence: A query row with empty results passes and receives zero metrics; existing test only rejects empty run file.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Use 28 query rows each containing `results: []`.
findings.required_correction: Reject empty per-query rankings and add hand fixture.
findings.why_it_matters: Malformed forensic run can silently influence aggregates.

findings.changes_experimental_design_or_results: No design change; evidentiary status can change.
findings.evidence: Corrected R5 runner accepts arbitrary inputs, omits count/uniqueness/version/SHA checks, and records output hashes only; command/Git/dependencies absent.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Overwrite canonical output using dirty benchmark files.
findings.required_correction: Add exact path/hash/contracts, command, Git, environment/dependency versions, and input hashes; reconcile existing bytes without tuning.
findings.why_it_matters: BM25/FAISS pilot artifacts lack executable linkage to exact R5 inputs.

findings.evidence: Freeze script requires absent owner-approved R4 files; two hash targets missing; test checks QA parity only, not qrels. Wall-clock approval timestamp also prevents byte-identical regeneration.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Run script against current pilot root.
findings.required_correction: Use preserved R4 candidate and explicit frozen approval timestamp; add ID-aligned QA and qrels parity tests; add non-destructive provenance correction.
findings.why_it_matters: R5 freeze provenance cannot be reproduced from committed inputs.

findings.changes_experimental_design_or_results: No current artifacts; future mismatches rejected.
findings.evidence: Retrieval does not enforce query manifest hash; evaluator records but does not compare R5/BM25/FAISS hashes to frozen expected values.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Modify canonical query or baseline ranking file.
findings.required_correction: Pin and verify exact query, R5 QA/qrels, BM25, and FAISS hashes before computation.
findings.why_it_matters: Dirty in-place inputs can produce apparently valid rerun/comparison.

findings.changes_experimental_design_or_results: Likely trace only, not chunk ranking metrics.
findings.evidence: Equal window scores retain FAISS return order rather than explicit window-ID tie.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Two same-chunk windows with equal score.
findings.required_correction: Tie-break equal scores by ascending window ID.
findings.why_it_matters: Winning-window trace may be nondeterministic.

findings.evidence: Non-equivalent CI receives label `not equivalent`.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: CI overlaps ±0.05.
findings.required_correction: Change wording to inconclusive; preserve CI/boolean.
findings.why_it_matters: Preregistered rule requires `inconclusive` when interval touches/crosses margin.

findings.changes_experimental_design_or_results: No current artifacts; current rankings resolved independently.
findings.evidence: Ranking validation checks duplicates/ranks but not frozen chunk membership.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Insert unknown ID below top 10.
findings.required_correction: Validate every ranking ID against chunk map.
findings.why_it_matters: Unknown IDs can be scored as irrelevant or escape if below pool cutoff.

findings.evidence: Each validation query runs combined BM25+Graph+fusion and then separate BM25/Graph calls; metadata reports only 34-query validation pass.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Trace call sequence in `measure_latency`.
findings.required_correction: Disclose exact component/fusion invocation counts or reuse first-call component outputs.
findings.why_it_matters: Pre-measurement component warming counts are understated.

findings.evidence: Point-estimate sign is labelled `improves` although strongest-comparator CI includes zero.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Inspect Hybrid−BM25 MRR@10 CI.
findings.required_correction: Use `point_estimate_higher_but_inconclusive` and preserve H4 no-support.
findings.why_it_matters: Wording is stronger than exploratory inconclusive evidence.

findings.evidence: Several tests validate existing generated values/counts/hashes instead of independent recomputation from raw rankings/qrels.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Modify generator and snapshots together.
findings.required_correction: Add independent read-only per-query/aggregate recomputation tests.
findings.why_it_matters: Generator and artifacts can be coherently wrong.

findings.evidence: Theoretical 150 all-retry attempts conflicts in terminology with 50 authorized network attempts.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Compare aggregate and mode envelopes.
findings.required_correction: Separate logical calls, hard authorized attempt cap, and uncapped theoretical retry demand.
findings.why_it_matters: Call/token envelope is ambiguous.

findings.changes_experimental_design_or_results: No current artifacts if existing order confirmed; future bad inputs rejected.
findings.evidence: Paired bootstrap zips arrays without asserting equal query-ID order or length. Later Phase 3/4 code includes this guard, showing expected contract.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Pass same queries in different order.
findings.required_correction: Assert exact paired query-ID sequence and equal nonzero length before resampling.
findings.why_it_matters: Misordered inputs silently create invalid paired effects.

reconciliation.resolution: Critical under supplied severity rule for known credential exposure; repository contains no key value.
Retained as High procedural limitation. No key/project identifier may be stored, so same-environment owner attestation is required rather than cryptographic identity storage.
Accepted as Medium metadata defect; measured values remain unchanged.
Retained Medium before final evidence, not a claim that current metrics are numerically wrong.

remaining_uncertainty: Rotation/replacement of previously exposed Gemini key is not independently verified.
Free-tier/project state cannot be cryptographically bound without storing a prohibited identifier; owner attestation remains procedural.
Gemini stable model name is not an immutable dated snapshot; no returned modelVersion exists before trace.
Local tokenizer is experimental; provider usage metadata may differ.
Raw Gemini response archive is SDK serialization, not captured wire bytes.
Four historical code-hash claims are not recoverable from reachable committed versions, although preserved output bytes remap and verify.
Corpus-backed Graph alias evidence is verified; historical independence of alias choice from observed v3.1 behavior cannot be proved from artifacts alone.
verified_strengths: 419/419 scoped files dispositioned; all 66 Python, 220 JSON, and 103 JSONL files parsed.
Phase 0 binary versus graded nDCG separation and historical root-cause explanation are supported.
R5 has 34 unique questions, six category counts 6/6/6/6/6/4, and 48 unique resolving grade-2 qrels. Status remains AI-assisted and owner-authorized; qrels remain non-exhaustive.
Final corrected FAISS-windowed-max uses normalized MiniLM windows, IndexFlatIP, max-window chunk scoring, and deterministic chunk-ID ranking tie.
Invalid Graph V1/v3.1 candidates remain excluded from corrected pools; Graph v3.2 scoring and aliases are strongly tested.
Hybrid enforces BM25 plus Graph v3.2, equal weights, k=60, and exact 1/(k+rank) RRF. Warm-cache latency is explicitly not cold-start.
Prompt treats candidates as untrusted; strict parser enforces all 50 unique IDs and integer 0-3 scores; ranking is score-descending/chunk-ID-ascending.
No fallback/backfill; 429 is excluded from retry statuses; no live Phase 5 run/output exists.
Blind/sealed pools align at 504, 610, and 620 unique pairs without sealed fields in blind rows.
Secret scan found no candidate secret in 419 scoped files or branch commits.
